title: Trade link
description: A trading bot or terminal that alert bots link to from a token card: the URL templates to open a token (with or without a referral code) and to refer a user. Placeholders: {token} (mint or contract address), {ref} (your referral code), {pool} (pool address), {dexscreenerId} (from chains.json).

chains.description: Registry chain dirs this app can trade on (solana, evm-4663, …).

token.description: Opens the token; may need {ref}. null when the app has no documented token deep link.

tokenNoRef.description: Opens the token without a referral code, when that is a different URL.

referral.description: Refers a user without a token. null when the app has no referral program or no public format.

verified.description: production = used by live bots we run; docs = the app's own documentation; community = third-party guides and links in the wild.
